title: yliveticker · Yahoo Finance
description: Live Yahoo Finance ticks from an east-to-west global watchlist are stored in InfluxDB 2 (ticker_data). SYNTH-* prices appear only in the explicit synthetic test feed.

options.content:
**Live Yahoo Finance feed · east-to-west watchlist · [InfluxDB](http://localhost:8086) bucket `ticker_data`.**

Charts use your browser timezone (`${__timezone}`); switch the time picker to UTC whenever preferred. Info bubbles identify exchange-local regular sessions. Empty price charts intentionally keep sleeping markets visible; unavailable volume charts are omitted. Holidays, special sessions, DST and Yahoo delays can change coverage. `SYNTH-*` is CI-only. [Details](https://github.com/yahoofinancelive/yliveticker/blob/feat/pooling-and-grafana/docker/README.md).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: -30s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.id =~ /^SYNTH-/ then 1 else 0}))

panels.title: Stored ticks (selected range)
panels.description: Price records read from InfluxDB; count excludes volume fields. Zero means no ticks have reached storage in this time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: now(), _field: "stored_ticks"}))

panels.title: Received ticks/min (last 60s)
panels.description: Ticks received by the collector during the latest rolling 60 seconds. This uses local receipt time, not Yahoo's possibly delayed market-event timestamp.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker_ingest" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: now(), _field: "received_ticks_per_minute"}))

panels.title: Received ticks per minute
panels.description: One-minute ingestion counts using collector receipt time. Empty minutes are shown as zero; Yahoo event timestamps may be older for delayed exchanges.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker_ingest" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)

panels.title: Latest price
panels.description: Last observed price in the selected range, in each symbol’s quote currency.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price")
  |> last()

panels.title: Time since last tick
panels.description: Scrollable age table for the latest Yahoo timestamp per observed symbol in the selected range. Closed markets naturally become stale; symbols without a tick in range have no row.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price")
  |> group(columns: ["id"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Symbol: r.id, Age: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Symbol"])

panels.title: ${symbol:raw}: price
panels.description: ${symbol:text}. Session times are exchange-local; chart timestamps use `${__timezone}`. Last observed price per display window, in the instrument’s quote currency. This panel stays visible as No data when the market is closed or silent. Holidays, special sessions, DST and Yahoo delays can change observed coverage.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: ${volume_symbol:raw}: reported session volume (cumulative)
panels.description: ${volume_symbol:text}. Session times are exchange-local; chart timestamps use `${__timezone}`. Positive Yahoo dayVolume values as received. This is cumulative session volume, not per-candle or interval volume. Instruments without meaningful dayVolume are omitted rather than showing a misleading zero.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id =~ /^${volume_symbol:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "volume" and r._value > 0.0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

list.name: symbol
list.label: Symbols
list.query:
import "array"

marketInfo = (id) =>
  if id == "BTC-USD" then "BTC-USD · Global · Bitcoin · trades 24/7"
  else if id == "EURUSD=X" then "EURUSD=X · Global FX · EUR/USD · 24 hours Sunday–Friday"
  else if id == "GC=F" then "GC=F · COMEX · gold futures · Sun–Fri 17:00–16:00 CT; daily 16:00–17:00 break"
  else if id == "FPH.NZ" then "FPH.NZ · New Zealand (NZX) · Fisher & Paykel Healthcare · regular session 10:00–16:45 local time"
  else if id == "BHP.AX" then "BHP.AX · Australia (ASX) · BHP · regular session 10:00–16:00 local time"
  else if id == "7203.T" then "7203.T · Japan (Tokyo) · Toyota · regular sessions 09:00–11:30 and 12:30–15:30 local time"
  else if id == "0700.HK" then "0700.HK · Hong Kong · Tencent · regular sessions 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–16:00 local time"
  else if id == "D05.SI" then "D05.SI · Singapore · DBS Group · regular sessions 09:00–12:00 and 13:00–17:00 local time"
  else if id == "RELIANCE.NS" then "RELIANCE.NS · India · Reliance Industries · regular session 09:15–15:30 local time"
  else if id == "EMAAR.AE" then "EMAAR.AE · Dubai · Emaar Properties · regular session 10:00–15:00 local time"
  else if id == "NPN.JO" then "NPN.JO · South Africa · Naspers · regular session 09:00–17:00 local time"
  else if id == "SAP.DE" then "SAP.DE · Germany (Xetra) · SAP · regular session 09:00–17:30 local time"
  else if id == "HSBA.L" then "HSBA.L · United Kingdom (London) · HSBC · regular session 08:00–16:30 local time"
  else if id == "AAPL" then "AAPL · United States (Nasdaq) · Apple · regular session 09:30–16:00 ET"
  else if id == "NVDA" then "NVDA · United States (Nasdaq) · NVIDIA · regular session 09:30–16:00 ET"
  else if id == "SHOP.TO" then "SHOP.TO · Canada (Toronto) · Shopify · regular session 09:30–16:00 ET"
  else if id == "VALE3.SA" then "VALE3.SA · Brazil (São Paulo) · Vale · regular session 10:00–17:00 BRT"
  else id + " · Market and regular-session metadata unavailable"

defaults = array.from(rows: [{_value: "BTC-USD"}, {_value: "EURUSD=X"}, {_value: "GC=F"}, {_value: "FPH.NZ"}, {_value: "BHP.AX"}, {_value: "7203.T"}, {_value: "0700.HK"}, {_value: "D05.SI"}, {_value: "RELIANCE.NS"}, {_value: "EMAAR.AE"}, {_value: "NPN.JO"}, {_value: "SAP.DE"}, {_value: "HSBA.L"}, {_value: "AAPL"}, {_value: "NVDA"}, {_value: "SHOP.TO"}, {_value: "VALE3.SA"}])

observed = from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "price")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.id}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct()

union(tables: [defaults, observed])
  |> group()
  |> distinct()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r._value + "|" + marketInfo(id: r._value)}))
